jobs.description:
The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

Wat ga je doen?                
We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).You'll work in a 2 shift system.One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

As Partnership Manager, you will play a central role in developing and maintaining ESN International's corporate partnerships, ensuring that they create meaningful benefits for international students, volunteers and the organisation. You will manage existing relationships, identify new business opportunities and help strengthen the financial sustainability of ESN International through mission-aligned partnerships.

Working closely with ESN's leadership and internal teams, you will combine relationship management, business development and the implementation of partnership activities.Account Management & Business Relations

• Serve as the main point of contact in all matters related to current partners' concerns and needs, building and strengthening client relationships to achieve long-term partnerships. 
• Maintain accurate client records, keeping track of contractual conditions, commitments and Key Performance Indicators. 
• Work with other internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure ESN's commitments towards partners are being fulfilled. 
• Manage and develop affiliate marketing and direct marketing strategies for ESN and its partners.
 

ESNcard Support & Roll-out of membership benefits

• Support the development of ESNcard.org and ErasmusCareers.org to improve international students' membership experience with the Erasmus Student Network.
• Coordinate the customer support of queries from students related to student offers and membership questions. 
• Maintain ESN's content management system related to student offers and its linked communication channels, to monitor promotion and visibility of corporate partnerships.
• Analyse data on usage and student engagement to assess impact and improve the offer and engagement.
 

Fundraising

• Identify key areas to further develop ESN's business relations connected to international student mobility, and prepare the acquisition of new partnerships in the corporate world
• Identify trends in corporate needs or opportunities in industries like tech, travel, or education; areas aligned with ESN's mission.
• Implement the partnership strategy to foster sustainable fundraising in cooperation with the Treasurer of ESN.
• Develop ESN's capacity to connect with business partners and foundations to offer them a solution for Corporate Social Responsibility. 
• Fundraise to roll out programs that address ESN International, in collaboration with internal teams in other departments to implement impactful initiatives with external stakeholders. 
• Identify potential diversification of ESN's corporate partnership portfolio and engagement of said partners. 
• Preferably a Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
• Experience working in an NGO, membership organisation or student-led organisation.
• Excellent negotiation skills to negotiate high-level commercial partnerships at the European level.
• Ability to manage and coordinate different stakeholder needs.
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both oral and written: capable of leading negotiations and writing marketing copy.
• Great project management skills: budgeting, meeting deadlines and stakeholder management.
• An innovative and structured approach towards upcoming challenges.
• Proactive attitude. Not afraid of proposing changes and taking ownership of full projects and tasks.
• Ability to motivate and influence big networks of volunteers.
• Ability to manage and mentor the Digital Marketing Intern daily.
• Likes to work in teams and feels comfortable in a multicultural environment.
• Knowledge of the following will be highly appreciated:
• Affiliate and Referral marketing
• Social media marketing
• Email marketing
• Google Analytics
• Financial management
• Contract and/or Commercial law
• GDPR and other Data Privacy regulations 
• Full-time position (38 hours per week);
• One-year contract (prolongation depending on external funding);
• Gross monthly salary between €2500 and €2800, corresponding to ESN International's salary framework. Placement within the range will be determined by objective criteria, including relevant professional experience and competencies.
• A 13th month and holiday pay in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditions.
• Additional benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and public transport reimbursement.
• Access to further training (congé éducation) during working hours;
• Opportunities for professional development beyond training, such as networking or access to international conferences.
• Casual, friendly work environment;

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Are you an experienced CNC operator looking for a new challenge? We urgently need skilled professionals to join our team at our brand-new machine shop! Our workshop has moved to a location 10 times larger with many more machines, and we’re looking for enthusiastic people to help us grow!

• Experience in CNC programming, turning, and milling (if you only have turning experience, we have options, but milling experience alone is not sufficient).
• Experience with 5-axis machines and knowledge of more than 3-axis operations.
• Familiarity with Fanuc, Siemens, and Mazatrol Smooth.
• English is sufficient for communication in our workshop.
• Willingness to work in Day shift. We are open to considering day shifts.
• 95% of programming happens at the machine using dialog control (ShopMill and ShopTurn, Siemens 840D Solution Line).
• You must have a good understanding of G- and M-codes.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Location : Brussels (Diegem area)
Work model : Full on-site (no remote)

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Full-time Open-Ended Contract (CDI)

We are looking for a motivated Junior IT Officer to join an internal IT team and support the daily technology needs of employees across the organisation.

This position offers a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their IT career to develop their technical skills, gain hands-on experience and work with a variety of modern workplace technologies.

You will primarily be responsible for first-line IT support while contributing to the improvement of internal IT processes and discovering new digital tools.
Key Responsibilities

• 
Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding IT-related issues and support requests.

• 
Manage, troubleshoot and follow up on IT support tickets.

• 
Prepare, configure and deploy laptops, mobile devices and other IT equipment.

• 
Handle IT-related onboarding and offboarding activities.

• 
Provide user support for Microsoft 365 applications and workplace technologies.

• 
Assist with the implementation and adoption of new digital tools, including AI and automation solutions.

• 
Identify opportunities to improve internal IT processes and the overall user experience.

• 
Work closely with experienced IT colleagues and system administrators to resolve technical issues.

• 
Bachelor's degree or Graduate degree in IT, Computer Science, ICT, Applied Computer Science or a related field.

• 
First professional experience in IT support is an advantage, but recent graduates are welcome.

• 
Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, workplace technologies and Microsoft 365.

• 
Strong interest in technology, digital innovation and emerging tools.

• 
Practical problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach.

• 
Proactive, curious and eager to learn.

• 
Good communication skills and a service-oriented mindset.

• 
Comfortable working independently as well as part of a team.

• 
Excellent command of Dutch and a good knowledge of English and French.

• 
Willingness to travel occasionally between different office locations.

• 
A category B driving licence is considered mandatory

Our client is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Junior Associate with a strong interest in the financial sector and an affinity for IT and digital solutions to join its Operations department.
The Operations department consists of approximately 60 colleagues based in Brussels and manages a broad range of services related to banking products and transactions.
These activities include post-trade processing, cash and payment services, portfolio transfers, tax services, income and corporate actions, and account administration.

 
As an Operations – Cash & Payments Junior Associate, you will: 

 
• Process payment and treasury transactions accurately and efficiently, ensuring high-quality data and excellent service to both internal and external clients. 
 
• Perform operational support activities based on scheduled or ad hoc requests, including account closures, interest adjustments, reconciliation as well as investigation and controls on transactions 
 
• Contribute to the development and implementation of new processes and systems, as well as the continuous improvement of existing ones, with the aim of increasing efficiency, complying with new regulations and market standards, and reducing operational risk. 
 
• Proactively follow and integrate operational and procedural changes to keep your knowledge and expertise up to date. 
 
• Participate in knowledge sharing and training, both receiving training from colleagues and sharing your own expertise across the department. 

 
• A Master's degree or equivalent experience, preferably within the financial sector. 
 
• French or Dutch as your main language, combined with a very good command of the other national language and English. 
 
• A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to learn and share knowledge. 
 
• A dynamic, proactive and confident personality. 
 
• A strong client-focused mindset and good communication skills. 
 
• Strong analytical skills, combined with the ability to synthesize complex information. 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong general digital skills.

• Perform a variety of laboratory tests according to standard procedures 
 
• Work with pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, spectrophotometers, ovens and incubators 
 
• Test enzyme activity in finished products 
 
• Sample incoming laboratory materials 
 
• Carry out wash tests on fabric samples 
 
• Collect water, air, equipment swab, environmental and raw-material samples 
 
• Prepare product batches for different departments 
 
• Calibrate equipment and replace Millipore filters 
 
• Register ICE tickets and maintain accurate laboratory data 
 
• Help improve procedures and workflows 
 
• Follow quality and safety procedures with care and consistency 

You have an A2 qualification in Sciences/Chemistry or relevant laboratory experience, and you are comfortable communicating in English.

Has an eye for detail
Takes quality seriously
Enjoys practical laboratory work
Is comfortable with Microsoft Office
Follows procedures while looking for opportunities to improve the way things are done

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

As a Legal Assistant in Brussels, you will provide organised administrative and secretarial support within a Professional Services setting. You will help keep daily legal documentation, correspondence and diary activities running smoothly for the business.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Description

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.
 

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:
• Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
• Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
• Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
• Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
• Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
• Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

• You have initial experience as a renovation worker
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are not afraid of physical work
